## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's imaginary friend who lives behind the glass doors of the bookcase. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents and speaks to her as a beloved companion to cope with her solitary life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)_
